$comment: Contract for the UpdateUser server-side command (AD-003, AD-041). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_UpdateUser). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_UpdateUser
customApi.description: An administrator amends an existing application user's display name (al_user). Work email is the stable identifier (AD-010) and is not changed here. Enforces the AD-041 permission.manage Manage permission, applies optimistic concurrency and idempotency, and writes an immutable Audit Event (BR-012).

requestParameters.name: UserId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_user record to update.

requestParameters.name: ExpectedRowVersion
requestParameters.description: Row version read by the client, for optimistic concurrency.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when the command was rejected for a concurrency conflict.
